def test_e2e_order_flow():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"

    # 1. Register user
    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify user creation
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("username") == username

    # 2. Login
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # 3. Add address
    address_payload = {
        "city": "Springfield",
        "country": "USA",
        "number": "742",
        "postcode": "12345",
        "street": "Evergreen Terrace",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert address_id is not None

    # Verify address
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{address_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("city") == "Springfield"

    # 4. Add card
    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert card_id is not None

    # Verify card
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("expires") == "12/25"

    # 5. Get catalogue item
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), params={"size": 1}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0
    item_id = items[0]["id"]
    unit_price = items[0]["price"]

    # 6. Add item to cart
    cart_item = {"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 2, "unitPrice": unit_price}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify cart
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cart_items = resp.json()
    assert len(cart_items) == 1
    assert cart_items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert cart_items[0]["quantity"] == 2

    # 7. Place order
    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    order_id = order.get("id")
    assert order_id is not None
    assert order["customer"]["username"] == username

    # Verify order
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["id"] == order_id

    # Verify customer orders search
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", "/orders/search/customerId"), params={"custId": username}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer_orders = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("customerOrders", [])
    assert len(customer_orders) > 0
    assert any(o["id"] == order_id for o in customer_orders)

    # 8. Verify payment authorization was recorded by the order process
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    payments = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(payments, list)
    assert len(payments) > 0
    assert payments[0]["orderId"] == order_id

    # 9. Verify shipment was recorded by the order process
    resp = requests.get(get_url("shipping-http", f"/shipping/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["orderId"] == order_id

def test_user_customer_management():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    # Register
    payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "pwd",
        "email": f"{username}@test.com",
        "firstName": "F",
        "lastName": "L"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Add address
    address_payload = {
        "city": "C",
        "country": "C",
        "number": "1",
        "postcode": "1",
        "street": "S",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Get customer addresses
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addresses = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert len(addresses) > 0

    # Delete customer
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("status") is True

    # Delete again -> status false
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("status") is False

        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",

        "lastName": "User"
    }

    # Register
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Register again -> 409 Conflict
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Login with wrong password -> 401 Unauthorized
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, "wrongpassword"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_orders_negative_paths():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    # Place order with missing fields -> 406 Not Acceptable
    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 406, f"Expected 406, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Place order with invalid address URI format -> 404 Not Found
    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/invalid_format",
        "card": f"/cards/{username}:1234",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Get non-existent order -> 404
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", "/orders/non_existent_order_id"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_carts_operations():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    item_id = f"item_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    # Add item
    item_payload = {"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": 9.99}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify item added
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 1

    # Update item
    item_payload["quantity"] = 5
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify item updated
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 5

    # Delete item
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify item deleted
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Delete cart
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify cart is empty
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert len(resp.json()) == 0

def test_catalogue_operations():

def test_payment_authorization():
    order_id = f"order_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    payment_payload = {
        "address": {"city": "C", "country": "C", "number": "1", "postcode": "1", "street": "S"},
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456"},
        "customer": {"firstName": "F", "lastName": "L"},
        "orderId": order_id
    }

    # Authorize payment
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("authorised") is True

    # Verify payment recorded
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    payments = resp.json()
    assert len(payments) == 1
    assert payments[0]["orderId"] == order_id

    # Authorize again
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify multiple payments recorded
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert len(resp.json()) == 2
